dsk.text: Duskmourn begins as a plane whose people, discontent with scarce magic, learned to summon hungry creatures from the void, and when one proved too great to control it was bound in an ordinary house, where someone accepted its contract and freed it to feed.
The House swallowed the rest of the world until only Duskmourn and survivors in its walls remained, and then it learned to open new doors in new places, reaching out to feed on other worlds.

Duskmourn can now hunt, luring visitors with a door that vanishes behind them, rebuilding the people it takes into razorkin, and sending an army of monsters pouring into the carnival while attacking or erasing every settlement the survivors still reach.

Inside, the House tests its newcomers with visions and lures, as Niko traps a glitch ghost in a shard, the Wanderer narrowly averts a deadly vision, and Zimone and Tyvar find a room of carved doors and realize the House is setting lures in other places.
